value.rationale: All n-vertex trees of diameter at most three form a complete natural family under changing two hub pendant counts. A singleton-cluster count is a canonical site-percolation observable. The strict imbalance ordering gives a full sharp minimizer/maximizer classification, a positive transfer margin, and a factor-two asymptotic contrast; it is not a one-off finite value or a renaming of edge percolation.
